body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Stealth Acoustics expects to launch its invisible speaker 'AX3' at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. Since it can be installed to any kinds of wall or frames without mounting bracket, it appears to be a nice complement to interior design. Suggested price is 1,500 USD.
